product_metadata.title: Estilo Bathroom Trash Can - Round Brushed Stainless Steel Small Step Trash Can With Lid - Mini Garbage Bin, 5L
features: High Quality Design - Made of high quality brushed stainless steel that is resistant to fingerprints and rust.
Strong Steel Pedal - The super strong stainless steel pedal is built to last for years to come.
Product Dimensions - This small trash bin is 8 inches in diameter and 11 inches in height.
Trash Bin Holds - 5 Liter (1.32 Gallons) the perfect size for the office and bathroom.
Removable Inner Bucket - Inner bucket lifts out for easy trash disposal and clean up.
description: The Estilo classic round can has a compact size that's perfect for small spaces, such as under a desk, office or in a bathroom. Durable steel pedal and stainless steel construction. A removable inner bucket makes trash disposal easy. Made of high quality brushed stainless steel to resist fingerprints and rust. Super strong stainless steel pedal. Non-skid base with rubber pads is gentle on floors. "Removable inner bucket" makes it easy to remove bag and clean. Dimensions: 8" in diameter and 11" in height.
